extracted.intended_audience: comedy fans, voters, and performers interested in submitting jokes/videos/merch or entering Laugh Factory contests
extracted.subtask_description: Site-specific instructions and minimal entry/voting rules for Laugh Factory activities: voting for the 100 greatest comedians, submitting jokes/videos/photos, uploading images, entering contests (e.g., World Cup of Comedy), and sending merch designs. Mostly procedural and promotional guidance rather than full contest rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Vote for up to 2 comedians
rubrics_metrics.description: VOTE FOR UP TO 2 COMEDIANS / Please Vote for up to 2 comedians of all time! We want to know about everybody!
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Click on 2 comedians, then press 'Vote Now!'. This is an explicit limit on votes per voter.

rubrics_metrics.name: Write-in option for missing comedians
rubrics_metrics.description: If you don’t see your favorite comedian, write them in below.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page invites users to add comedians not shown in the list (write-in entries), acknowledging the researchers may have missed some names.

rubrics_metrics.name: Image upload format for comedian pictures
rubrics_metrics.description: Please upoad an image of the comedians by pasting a link/image url in the picture upload area.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submission of images is required via a pasted URL (no in-page file upload instructions shown). Note: page contains a typo 'upoad'.

rubrics_metrics.name: All comedians chosen by an independent committee
rubrics_metrics.description: All comedians have been chosen by an independent committee.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates the initial candidate list was curated by a committee (selection process is not further detailed), so voters are selecting from a committee-curated set with an option to write-in others.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submit merch designs
rubrics_metrics.description: Submit merch designs — Send your creative ideas for a chance to get your design printed on merch!
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Promotional call-to-action; page offers a chance to have designs printed. A 'Click here for more instructions' link is referenced but detailed submission requirements are not present on this page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Enter contests (e.g., World Cup of Comedy / LF Funniest Person)
rubrics_metrics.description: Enter the World Cup of Comedy or other contest to win $10,000! / LF Funniest Person in the World — Win $10,000!
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Promotional contest invitation. The page advertises prize and contest names but does not supply full rules, eligibility, entry procedure, or judging criteria here (it references contests like 'Laugh Bowl', 'Funniest Person in the World').

rubrics_metrics.name: Submit jokes/photos/videos to become an exclusive member
rubrics_metrics.description: Submit your best content, jokes, photos, or videos to become an exclusive Laugh Factory member and have your content shared on our website.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Invitation to performers/content creators to submit 'best' material for possible sharing and membership; 'best' is subjective and no formal quality rubric or technical specs are provided on this page. The page prompts 'Let's see what our Doctors of the Soul have to say.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Kid-friendly content for Kids Comedy Playground
rubrics_metrics.description: Kids Comedy Playground — Children Are Already Funny. Let’s encourage them! Kid friendly comedy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies a kid-friendly orientation for submissions or programming aimed at children; implies content should be appropriate for children but no detailed standards are listed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Voting UI instruction: select then submit
rubrics_metrics.description: Click on 2 comedians, Then press vote Now! / Vote Now!
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Operational instruction for interacting with the voting interface: select up to two choices, then submit. Reinforces vote limit and submission action.

rubrics_metrics.name: Account / authentication and social login
rubrics_metrics.description: Connect with Facebook — We'll never post to Facebook without your permission. We will access Facebook to get and use your email address, friend list, interests, likes and public profile...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Login or account activation may be required for some interactions; social login will access and use specified Facebook data per the site's privacy policy. Users are pointed to the Privacy Policy for details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Copyright and content ownership notice
rubrics_metrics.description: Copyright Notice: This website is protected by U.S. and International copyright laws. Reproduction and distribution of content, with or without modification, without written permission of Laugh Factory Inc., is prohibited.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Users should assume content on the site is copyrighted; submissions may be subject to site ownership/terms (though explicit submission-to-site IP terms are not shown on this page).
